{{ShowBracket|id=4O9UxWcF6v}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Two groups of four
** Single Round Robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo2}}
** {{bgcolortext|up|Top two}} from each group qualify for Playoffs
** {{bgcolortext|down|Bottom two}} from each group are seeded into [[NLB/2014/Summer|NLB Summer]]
* '''Playoffs'''
** Single elimination bracket
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** If a series reaches Game 5, said game will be played in ''Blind Pick'' mode
